name: Matjiesfontein
story: This Karoo settlement makes the rail connection visible: its museum occupies the station building itself.
history: James Douglas Logan obtained the station refreshment room concession in 1884; the station precinct now contains a railway museum.

experience.activity: Explore the Railway Museum and its former station master’s office and signal room.
